stem: Which sentence from the selection shows that locating food is a priority for bats?

options.label: A
options.text: Soon a huge cloud of as many as 20 million bats has formed in the dark sky. (paragraph 2)

options.label: B
options.text: The bats will eat about 200 tons (181 metric tons) of these bugs in one night. (paragraph 7)

options.label: C
options.text: As they soar high into the air, the bats use their wings to scoop prey into their mouths. (paragraph 8)

options.label: D
options.text: In this process, bats send out high-pitched sounds that travel in waves. (paragraph 9)
